'''Brian Fred 2-24 Lafayette Indiana (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Brian Fred]] posted on DeckTech on 25 February 2002 about [[February 2002 Lafayette tournament]].<ref name="tr-d3401">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-2-24-lafayette-indianad3401/ 2-24-lafayette-indiana], DeckTech (john "comando" matrix, 25 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-25-2-24-lafayette-indianad3401/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Brian Fred's props-and-slops note on the 24 February 2002 Lafayette tournament, posted after DeckTech erased his first report; his full report is [[Brian Fred Lafayette Indiana 2-24 Take 2 (tournament report)]].

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Brian Fred]] (byline: john "comando" matrix)
* '''Published:''' 25 February 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''2-24 Lafayette Indiana''
* '''Event:''' [[February 2002 Lafayette tournament]]
* '''Event date:''' 24 February 2002
* '''Site:''' The Game Preserve, Lafayette, Indiana

== Original report ==

'''2-24-lafayette-indiana'''
* '''Author:''' john "comando" matrix
* '''Published:''' Feb 25, 2002

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  i was gona do along report,but i jsut sat here for like 2 hours doing this report and at the end it told me i had to resign in.so i did,and i hit back so i could go back and clock finish again,and my report was gone.so i am not gona sit here and do another report.this is so stupid.i sit here and spend 2 hours typing up a kick @#$% report,and then it deletes it.@#$%ing bull@#$%.anyways all im gona do is props and slops cause i am not sitting here for another 2 hours.





props



steve horton for running the tournament,cause carlos is lazy



shaun nichter for loaning me 3 amidalas



kent saylor for flipping the hyperdrive objective twice



gungans fro springing the gungan trap twice



james corder for being # 1 after 2 games



shaun and tony for being the best play testing partners ever



melissa for being a great employee of the game preserve



richard rivenburg for coming out of retirment

slops



kent for palying hyperdrive



tony for quiting game 5



imperial barrier for making tony quit



kirk for snoring all night



kirks cats for scouting all our decks



josh for being a crappy employye of the game preserve



carlos for not running his onw tourny



deck tech for erasing my orignal toruny report



if anyone wants any more info go check out tony’s report,it should be up.see you all at the money tourny



sorry about not having a better tourny report all,but the one i did was awesome,and deck tech erased it.i am not spending another 2 hours to do it up again



brian fred-- aka(john matrix)
</nowiki></div>
